newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Fletcher Forest shrs hit 1-1/2 yr high.
newsitem.headline: Fletcher Forest shrs hit 1-1/2 yr high.

text.p: Shares in New Zealand's Fletcher Forest, a division of Fletcher Challenge Ltd, jumped 11 cents to a 1-1/2 year high of NZ$2.34 on Monday amid a general equities rally.
Brokers said Fletcher Forest was feeling the benefits of a strong debt market.
"Fletcher Forest is interest rate sensitive and the fact that longer bond yields have come down today is a benefit for it," said Geoff Brown, broker at Ord Minnett.
At 3.30 p.m. (0230 GMT), Fletcher Forest was steady at $2.34, its highest level since April 19, 1995, on hefty volume of 2.2 million shares.
The NZSE-40 Capital Index was up 14.93 points at 2,264.47.
